combo_label: Pets & Petcare × Cycling × The Wild West

entries.clue: Neck band carrying a name tag and a jingling bell
Flip-down metal prop that keeps a parked bike upright
Greasy loop of links that carries your effort to the back wheel
What you grip to steer, or a moustache curled at the ends
Slack line held at one end while the dog tows the other
Rail-fenced pen where horses are held before the ride out
Arena contest of bull riding and roping, won for a prize buckle
Boarding place, or the wooden hut a dog calls home
Barred enclosure with a water bottle clipped to the side
Fixed rod that a wheel spins around
Burning a hot iron mark into hide to prove who owns the beast
Tiny jumping biter that a drop on the neck sees off
